EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}You guessed it—{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}we're going to
play some good old-fashioned
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}hide-and-seek{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!
This is good, {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}wholesome fun—{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}
unlike those newfangled space-age
vidya games you kids play.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Como es de suponer,{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} en este
tour jugaremos al {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}escondite{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Un juego de los de siempre.
Sencillo y divertido, como debe
ser...{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}} ¡No como los vivajuegos esos
a los que jugáis ahora los jóvenes!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Cette excursion aura donc pour
thème...{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} une bonne vieille partie de
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}cache-cache{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} !
C'est indémodable !{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}} Pas comme ces
vilains jeux vidéo qui pervertissent
notre pauvre jeunesse, houerf !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Eccoci qua!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} E adesso un gioco
che non passa mai di moda...
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Nascondino{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!
Un sano passatempo... {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}Mica
come quei{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}} videogiochi cervellotici
di oggigiorno che usate voi giovani!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ganz genau:{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Wir spielen jetzt
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Verstecken{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}wie in der guten
alten Zeit, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}he he huff!
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Damals haben wir keine blinkenden
Videospieldinger gebraucht, um
Spaß zu haben!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tahmin ettin{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}: Eski usul
saklambaç oynuyoruz!{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}} Siz
çocukların{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} oynadığı{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} o uzay{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}} çağı
video oyunlarının aksine
tertemiz eğlence!

Anyway, there are {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}four{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} animals
hiding somewhere on the island.
All you've got to do is find them!
ES:
Iré al grano, ¡hay {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}cuatro {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}turistas

que encontrarlos a todos!
FR:
Bref... {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Quatre{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} animaux se cachent
quelque part sur cette île. Il te
suffit de les trouver pour gagner !
IT:
Ad ogni modo... Sull'isola sono
nascosti {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}quattro {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}animaletti. Tutto
quello che devi fare è trovarli!
TRANSLATION:

hayvan saklanıyor. Tek yapman
gereken hepsini bulmak!
